body:
## Summary

`generate_chat_conv` accepted multiple text content parts for user messages but rejected equivalent system and assistant messages. This change concatenates all-text lists for those two roles while preserving rejection of lists containing non-text parts.

The investigation reproduced the exact parser failures on the prepared base before editing. It also found an independent, still-open upstream candidate at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38008; no related fix was present in the prepared `main` checkout.

## Reproduction and validation

Before the change, constructing a `ChatCompletionRequest` and calling `generate_chat_conv(..., "chatml")` raised:

- `ValueError: The system message should be a single text.` for two system text parts
- `ValueError: The assistant's response should be a single text.` for two assistant text parts

After the change, those cases render as the exact concatenated strings. Tests also cover an empty system content list and mixed text/image rejection.

Commands run:

- `/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-0fc416dbe5ba/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/parser/test_conversation.py` — 80 passed
- `/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-0fc416dbe5ba/venv/bin/python -m pre_commit run --files python/sglang/srt/parser/conversation.py test/registered/unit/parser/test_conversation.py` — passed
- Python before/after parser reproductions — raw output retained under `reports/j-0fc416dbe5ba/evidence/`

## Limitations

No HTTP server or full-model run was performed. The defect is deterministic in request parsing before model/GPU execution, so GPU execution, model semantics, and distributed behavior were not claimed or evaluated. No native rebuild was applicable.

Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/37845
Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/910
